markets.question: Counter-Strike: FUT Esports vs OG (BO3)
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "FUT Esports" if FUT Esports win against OG in the named Counter-Strike match in the BLAST Bounty Qualifier, scheduled for January 13 at 6:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "OG" if OG win against FUT Esports in the Counter-Strike match.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.

markets.question: Series FUT Esports Rounds Handicap (-4.5)
markets.description:
